messages:
jamal: PSA: python sampleapp batching helper (embeddings -> rerank) blew up in prod. Getting 400: embedding dimension 1536 != model dimension 1024.
kevin: which model and sdk versions?
jamal: openembed-1024, sampleapp v0.3.2 (python). The helper merges local cache entries with freshly computed embeddings then posts to /v1/rerank. Dumped merge and found some vectors are length 1536.
abby: likely a cache parity issue: node sample tools historically saved vectors under key 'vectors' and used openembed-1536. python expects 'embedding' and 1024 dims.
nina: also saw an unrelated retry/auth quirk: when token expires mid-batch the retry logic replays the batch without refreshing the Authorization header, leading first retry to 401 then mixed shape errors on subsequent attempts. Sample log: HTTP 401 Token expired -> retrying -> HTTP 400 embedding dimension mismatch.
kevin: so two actionable fixes: 1) validate cached vectors on load and normalize fields to canonical key 'embedding' and expected dim; 2) ensure retry logic refreshes auth token before replaying a batch.
jamal: I'll open a patch: drop cache items whose length != expected_dim (log warning with cache key), normalize node 'vectors' -> 'embedding' on read, and call auth.refresh_token() in retries before replay.
abby: add a unit test that writes a fake cache entry with 1536 dims and asserts loader drops it. Also add an integration that simulates token expiry mid-batch and checks header refresh. I'll write the CLI repro too. Minimal curl to reproduce initial 400 for docs: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -d '{"model":"openembed-1024","input":["a","b"]}' then run rerank with a cache file containing a 1536-length vector.
nina: please add a short note to SDK parity doc about 'vectors' vs 'embedding' and include a tiny migration snippet and recommended validation.
jiamal: will do, linking PR when ready.
ci-bot: CI queued: sampleapp/patch-embed-cache -> staging
kevin: after staging deploy run devex/regress-embed-parity across archived caches.
abby: will post results here once complete. :thumbsup:
